ios.desc:
Visiting a new city and you don't know where to go? Bored on a Friday night and looking for something to do?

Launch the Evntures app and never wonder about what things there are to do ever again!

https://www.evntures.com
https://www.instagram.com/evnturesapp/
https://www.facebook.com/EvnturesApp/
https://www.linkedin.com/company/evntures/

Evntures, a mobile advertising company, that facilitates the discovery and uncovery of local events in major metropolitan areas.
Find Stuff  To Do!

Key Features for Event User:
•	No barrier to entry (No sign up required to download and find events immediately).
•	Find Events and places easily by looking at our map and list view.
•	Events Rated by people that are Nearby (like get real comments from users who are actually near the event).
•	Keep Track of events you’re Interested in.
•	Ask someone who's there if its good (all from the comfort of your couch).

Key Features for Event Provider:
•	Post Your Own Events.
•	Keep Track of all Your Events.
•	Get Real-Time Updates on Ongoing Events.
•	You see something say, You can ask something (if a user is writing negative or bad comments ask them on the spot).
